documents.title: B7G Kannada Rajyotsava 2026 Cultural Programme
documents.content: B7G Kannada Rajyotsava 2026 cultural programmes are on two days: 31 October 2026 and 1 November 2026. The 31 October programme is a cultural evening: singing, violin, kids dance, sand art, dance dramas, group singing, a dance-cum-skit and drama. On 1 November there are three sessions: a morning programme (invocation, Bhagavad Geeta recital, flute, speeches by the Chief Guests, flag hoisting, instrumental, vote of thanks), an afternoon programme (B7G Sante) and an evening programme (yoga performance, dances, singing, a ramp walk, Huli Dance and jamming). Exact start times, durations and venues for the programme have not been published.

The 31 October 2026 evening programme (Cultural Evening) of B7G Kannada Rajyotsava 2026 has 11 items, in this order:
1. Welcome, Invocation, Lighting the Lamp
2. SriRanga Group – Singing
3. Tanya PV – Violin
4. Danzo Chinnara Balaga – Kids Dance
5. Sand Art with Inhouse Team Singing
6. Rhythm of B7G – Dance Drama
7. Jai Bharat Juniors – Singing
8. Kannadave Satya – Dance Drama

10. Jeevanadi – Dance-cum-Skit

Exact timings have not been published.
